messages.subject: R and CCF
parts:
Hello, I come in peace from another GSoC org: Climate Code Foundation
(http://climatecode.org/).

One of our ideas ( http://code.google.com/p/ccc-gistemp/wiki/GSoC2011
) involves writing some R, which is why I'm here at all. I have a
matter i'd like to discuss, probably with the R Foundation GSoC admin
or a mentor able to speak on their behalf. Can your GSoC admin
contact me off-list please? (d...@climatecode.org).

Sorry if this is a little off-topic for the public list, but it I
didn't think it was appropriate for me to post to your mentors list.

David Jones
Climate Code Foundation
